name: group-by-monitor-source
title: Synthetics — Group overview by Monitor source (Heartbeat / Remote / Local)
_setupNote: Deterministic Heartbeat + Local shot in an isolated `qa` space so seeded monitors never pollute the real list (wipe = delete the space). Local: ui monitors created in the qa space. Heartbeat: bulk-indexed autodiscovery pings (no minikube, space-less → visible in every space) — ES read from QA_KIBANA_DIR/config/kibana.dev.yml. Remote is intentionally NOT here: a remote (CCS) monitor carries the remote's own `meta.space_id` (default), so a single qa view filters it out regardless of the CCS setting's space list. See group-by-remote-cluster.json for the Remote-cluster split (runs in the default space where the remote monitor lives).
